context: Price a USPS Ground Advantage retail parcel. Use these plugin data: prices effective 2026-10-04, zones effective 2026-10-01. Rules: max weight 70 lb; max length plus girth 130 in; oversized at over 108 in length plus girth, price by zone, no surcharges. Length is longest side; girth is twice the sum of the other two sides. For non-oversized parcels: round each side up to whole inches; if that product exceeds 1728 cu in, dimensional weight = product / 139 rounded up, capped at 70 lb; billed weight is the larger of actual weight and dimensional weight; tier is first tier whose max_weight is at least billed weight. Tiers: 4 oz (0.25), 8 oz (0.5), 12 oz (0.75), 15.999 oz (0.9999375), 1 lb, 2 lb, ..., 70 lb.
